digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and route registry
propositions: Twenty-one visible pure-intercept routes lack committed help artifacts and fail discovery under `rebar help <command>` and overview help.
Parser factories for intercept routes must supply nonblank descriptions and use the predicate `not route.hidden and not route.retired` to populate overview and help discovery.

Usage unwrapping and metavar normalization must move from gen_cli_reference.py to gen_cli_help.py and apply only to intercept routes without explicit parser usage, preserving multiline trusted-env usage.
Child parsers for identity create, identity use, and identity key must enable help actions to return child usage instead of top-level usage.
Config validate requires explicit help contract proof that control reaches build_validate handler and returns validate child help, distinct from overview visibility.

The exact nested-intercept set for handler-owned help fallthrough must remain audit, config, identity, llm, prompt, criteria, and workflow; the overview omit set must remain help, bridge-fsck, and bridge-probe.
